name: Conductor
summary: Bimanual pointing where the ray from one hand selects along its length at the point set by the other hand's ray.
howItWorks: The dominant hand aims a ray, and the second hand indicates where along it the selection should land, so targets at a specific depth, even occluded ones, can be chosen.

relationships.note: Both use the intersection of two rays.
